fusions.name: Warped Lunge
fusions.desc: You flicker up to 7 tiles to the target and strike it, which deals 14 arcane damage, up to 1.4 times that from full reach.

fusions.name: Wild Surge
fusions.desc: Raw arcana bursts from you, dealing 28 arcane damage that ignores resistance to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Pulled From Nowhere
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Quickened Pulse
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
